scope: exact dimensionless geometric witness only; no material prediction
control: one global normalized flux phi in [0,1], dose integral phi dt <= 1

dark_then_light_equal_dose.outcome: reaches target without entering failure sink

constant_flux_obstruction.proof: At x=2 every ray that reaches the target disk is inside the failure disk; all constant-flux schedules therefore fail first-hit selection.
constant_flux_obstruction.optimized_dark: all dark stress amplitudes in the model rescale (2,1) and miss the target disk
constant_flux_obstruction.constant_average_phi_1_over_2: reaches the target point only along a ray that first enters the failure disk

falsification.result: If light rescales both glide velocities proportionally, the switched path stays on the dark ray and this advantage disappears.

clearance_margin: sqrt(1/18)-21/100 > 0; a stochastic claim requires acquired diffusion/pinning/reaction rates
limitations: event centers are abstract reduced glide coordinates, not an experimentally mapped ZnS network
mobility ratios are dimensionless witness values, not measured parameters
line continuity, core chemistry, stacking-fault evolution, pinning and non-equilibrium noise are not fitted
the source ZnS paper establishes core-selective mobility changes, not this reaction schedule or retained endpoint
